headline.caveat: >$500B combined target across all six financiers, subject to final agreements; no per-firm allocation disclosed

nature_md: BlackRock is one of six financiers in NVIDIA's Aug 10, 2026 coalition targeting >$500B of third-party capital for compute-collateralized SPV financing of AI infrastructure. BlackRock's AI-infrastructure footprint is already the broadest of the six: GIP/HPS sponsor Meta's El Paso SPV (80% equity, $12.5B bonds), BlackRock funds hold >$3B of Hyperion notes, and BlackRock/GIP co-founded AIP (with Microsoft, NVIDIA, MGX, xAI) which just closed the $40B Aligned acquisition. Per-firm commitments undisclosed; agreements are MOUs.

accounting.payer_treatment_md: Prospective deployment of client capital across BlackRock/GIP/HPS strategies — fee-earning AUM, not BlackRock Inc. principal; nothing booked at MOU stage.
accounting.payee_treatment_md: Target capitalization for platforms not yet funded; >$500B is aspirational pending final agreements.
